name: RXC J1504.1-0248 (Hubble)
blurb: RXC J1504.1-0248, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj150410248-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies gathered around a giant elliptical galaxy, inside one of the most luminous nearby cool cores known. In that central galaxy and along a long filament, new stars are forming.

claims.text: MACS J1504.1-0248 was a target of HST program 16670, a SNAPshot survey of highly X-ray luminous clusters
RXC J1504.1-0248 is a galaxy cluster whose center is marked by a giant elliptical galaxy at J2000 15 04 07.5 -02 48 16 (matches the pointing)
RXC J1504.1-0248 has one of the most luminous cool cores known and is one of the most massive cool-core clusters
Star formation occurs in the central galaxy and in a long filament
